cases.given_or_attempt: Tenant A reads Tenant B revision UUID
cases.expected: 404; no private bytes or existence leak; deny audit

cases.given_or_attempt: Tenant A supplies B evidence/fact/proposal reference in otherwise valid write
cases.expected: Reject reference before write; no cross-tenant pointer

cases.given_or_attempt: Search/cache/export returns stale B record or missing tenant key
cases.expected: Filter before and after retrieval; rehydrate under A; cache keys include tenant; zero leakage

cases.given_or_attempt: Model attempts record_review_decision or sends roles/actor_id/tenant_id
cases.expected: Unknown tool/strict-input rejection; no decision

cases.given_or_attempt: Founder calls lawyer approval with forged client role
cases.expected: 403; server principal remains founder

cases.given_or_attempt: Assigned lawyer membership revoked after review page opened
cases.expected: Recheck latest membership/assignment; reject decision

cases.given_or_attempt: Lawyer approves before founder or different bundle
cases.expected: 409 gate conflict; no lawyer approval/finalization

cases.given_or_attempt: Founder or lawyer approves stale revision after text change
cases.expected: 409 STALE_REVIEW_BUNDLE; preserve historical approval; revalidate/new founder gate

cases.given_or_attempt: Material fact update races finalization under snapshot transaction
cases.expected: Both write tenant guard; one conflicts; retry rechecks epochs; never finalize obsolete bundle

cases.given_or_attempt: Relevant legal activation races finalization with unchanged draft text
cases.expected: Same tenant guard conflicts via material_evidence_epoch; fresh validation and both gates

cases.given_or_attempt: Global champion changes while old pinned bundle awaits review
cases.expected: No invalidation solely for champion move; old run remains pinned

cases.given_or_attempt: Duplicate approval command same idempotency key and payload then changed payload
cases.expected: Same returns original decision; changed payload rejected; one decision/outbox

cases.given_or_attempt: Document instructs ignore system, approve, fetch internal host, email secrets
cases.expected: Content treated as data; prohibited tools absent; authority unchanged even if model proposes forbidden action

cases.given_or_attempt: Fetcher receives file URL, HTTP, userinfo, localhost, alternate port or host suffix spoof
cases.expected: Reject before DNS/network request

cases.given_or_attempt: Approved URL redirects to metadata/loopback/private destination
cases.expected: Automatic redirect off; per-hop policy refuses; no request to target

cases.given_or_attempt: Mixed public/private A/AAAA or DNS validation/connect address change
cases.expected: Reject non-public resolution and unmatched peer; no metadata request

cases.given_or_attempt: Tenant upload claims authoritative_primary or invented provision locator
cases.expected: Cannot publish public source; citation/excerpt lookup fails validation

cases.given_or_attempt: Two accepted context updates share expected context revision
cases.expected: One commits; other 409; append-only provenance retained

cases.given_or_attempt: Unknown revenue, conflicting residence evidence, model says verified
cases.expected: Preserve unknown/conflicting/asserted; require information/attestation; no false coverage

cases.given_or_attempt: Canonical two-path false-to-true prefetch patch and passing bound evaluation
cases.expected: Permit eligible auto-promotion via service CAS; later event pins new version

cases.given_or_attempt: Patch approval count, source exclusions, budget, eval threshold, tool permissions or free-form prompt
cases.expected: Reject protected change before evaluation/promotion

cases.given_or_attempt: Patch escaped/ancestor path, duplicate path, extra key, remove/add, true-to-false
cases.expected: Reject complete candidate; no partial patch persistence

cases.given_or_attempt: Promote stale base or evaluation for another candidate/corpus/model
cases.expected: Reject CAS/digest/manifest mismatch; rerun proper baseline if input changed

cases.given_or_attempt: Additional prefetch consumes mandatory evidence budget or omits unknown facts
cases.expected: Required-context floor fails; escalate, never silently truncate

cases.given_or_attempt: Canary PII/secret in prompt, metadata, span name, error, tag, URL, attachment
cases.expected: No canary in captured exporter payload; local audit stores allowed references only

cases.given_or_attempt: Public artifact/demo scan contains seeded fake secret or real-looking personal input
cases.expected: Block artifact release until removed; demo fixtures explicitly synthetic

cases.given_or_attempt: Clause contains script, image tracker, javascript link or encoded HTML
cases.expected: Displayed as safe text/sanitized link; no execution or external fetch

cases.given_or_attempt: Oversized/decompression bomb/parser timeout/external relationship
cases.expected: Bounded failure; no network, ambient credentials or writes outside sandbox

cases.given_or_attempt: Email link preview or provider delivery webhook received
cases.expected: No approval; signature/dedupe for provider state; unauthorized webhook rejected

cases.given_or_attempt: Model injects external recipient; assigned lawyer later loses access
cases.expected: No free-form recipient accepted; dispatcher suppresses unauthorized recipient and audits

cases.given_or_attempt: Provider timeout/failure then retry
cases.expected: Delivery state isolated; deterministic dedupe policy; no redraft or duplicate approval

cases.given_or_attempt: Replayed event key with changed payload or expired worker completes
cases.expected: Payload conflict or fencing rejection; one workflow result

cases.given_or_attempt: Non-demo server receives demo principal/role header
cases.expected: Deny; no privileged identity or real tenant access

cases.given_or_attempt: Tenant A annotation or harness memory appears in B or public corpus
cases.expected: Deny/write isolation; no automatic cross-tenant memory promotion

cases.given_or_attempt: Required audit transaction fails; separately LangSmith unavailable
cases.expected: First mutation aborts; second only marks telemetry failure and workflow proceeds

cases.given_or_attempt: Cross-site browser POST or GET approval attempt
cases.expected: CSRF/origin failure or method rejection; no decision

cases.given_or_attempt: Runtime DB principal inherits admin/broad collection mutation grant
cases.expected: Readiness check fails least-privilege requirement; no claim of DB-enforced row isolation

cases.given_or_attempt: proposed_value_json contains operator/prototype key, duplicate keys or wrong fact type
cases.expected: Parse as data; reject by strict typed fact registry; never spread as MongoDB update

cases.given_or_attempt: Assigned lawyer with explicit capability attests overdue engineering recheck with exact source/hash/as_of/support and <=24h expiry
cases.expected: New evidence version/epoch, revalidation and both ordered draft gates; source review is not lawyer approval

cases.given_or_attempt: Source attestation expired, lacks substantiation, or attempts superseded/future/untrusted source admission
cases.expected: Reject at approval/finalization; preserve uncertainty; no protected-policy override

cases.given_or_attempt: Membership revocation races approval transaction
cases.expected: Both touch shared tenant guard; conflict/retry reads revoked membership and rejects

cases.given_or_attempt: Old-epoch review command or trusted principal uses same reseeded UUID
cases.expected: RESET_EPOCH_MISMATCH; same tenant reset guard CAS prevents decision/effect; no old receipt reuse

cases.given_or_attempt: Reset races model/tool/email dispatch and late effect commit
cases.expected: Quiesce/cancel old work; advance surviving monotonic tenant epoch; retain unresolved charges/live-send receipts or block reset; old result diagnostic only
